title: Pranks on Posey and Art Whetsol
summary: The band put limburger cheese and cayenne pepper in Posey's mouthpiece and swapped Art Whetsol's valves around.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: (Laughter.) Oh, well, did I tell you that we used to play -- at one time the band used to play tricks on each other, you know? So, like Posey, he's always posing so much, so we fixed him. So we got limburger cheese and cayenne pepper and after we played a dance set he'd get off the stand and leave his horn on the chair, and we stuck the limburger cheese and the cayenne pepper in his mouthpiece because he had a way to lick it before he started playing.
And then, when we got back on the stand and getting ready to play and he'd pick up his horn and he went to lick it and he jumped almost to the ceiling and ran like mad. That was him.
Now, they took Art Whetsel's -- they changed his valves around and he couldn't blow nothing on it. He didn't know what was wrong with it. That's the second.
